race.description: Gj Gardner Yeppoon Cup Country Cups Qualifier Hcp
race.comment: JUNE (9) has the most direct last-start threat after finishing second in the same Emerald race as a well-supported favourite, with his 1400m record adding substance despite the wide draw. SIR ROCKET (7) brings winning form from Twin Hills and then held third at Rockhampton in provincial company, so he has enough recent substance to press the top two. BAYERISCHE (8) was plain in a Class 6 at Emerald but is a track-and-trip winner, drops in class and has the profile to improve third-up. PAPASITO (5) back from a 28-day let-up and has the benefit of a trial placing, in with a chance.
